title: BDP v0.1 staged schema bundle
description: Staged JSON Schema2020-12 artifact for the v0.1 selected-contract binding. Version and optional capability discovery are explicit; remaining inherited profile, Type, Event and advanced grammar is not an adoption or retention commitment. Complete retained-surface composition is required before advertising v0.1. The separate v0 artifact remains unchanged for held runtime/evidence.

ordinaryUpdateChange.description: An ordinary update input may supply no patch operations; a supplied array member is still required.

batchRequest.title: BDP optional atomic batch version 1 request

typeReference.description: A Type affiliation: an absolute HTTP(S) nominal Type identity, optionally pinned to an exact opaque definition revision. Local paths and creation bindings are not admitted. Types-profile stored/output affiliations require the pinned form; Core alone does not interpret definitions.

pinnedTypeReference.description: The common closed pinned Reference shape, restricted to the admitted absolute HTTP(S) Type identity domain. This does not impose Link endpoint or source-pin semantics.

atomicBatchSelection.description: Prefix selection only, not admission as a complete request. Unknown well-formed versions refuse without interpreting their body.

atomicBatchProblem.description: Existing ordinary Write Problems or the two feature-specific refusal forms; no public receipt failure carrier.

retainedDiscovery.title: Selected retained Core or Write discovery
